description: Edits, generates, and simulates nondeterministic finite automata.

methods.name: addEdge(source: string, target: string, type = TP_NFA_TRANSITION, sourcePort?: TpGraphPort, targetPort?: TpGraphPort, direction: TpGraphEdgeDirection = "forward"): TpGraphEdge
methods.description: Adds a forward transition between existing state IDs, using optional connection ports; returns the edge record. Unsupported types, directions or endpoints throw.

methods.name: addNode(type: string, point: TpGraphPoint, label?: string): TpGraphNode
methods.description: Adds a NFA state or comment at graph coordinates point with the optional label; returns a detached node record. Unsupported types throw TypeError.

methods.name: generate(source = this.regexSource): void
methods.description: Builds an NFA from the regular-expression source and resets reading to the current word. Omitted source reuses the stored expression; invalid expressions throw.

methods.name: readNext(duration = 500): Promise<boolean>
methods.description: Consumes and animates one input symbol using duration milliseconds. Resolves to true if a symbol was processed, not whether the word is accepted; false means no further step is possible.

methods.name: reset(word = this.inputWord): void
methods.description: Restarts reading word with the epsilon closure of the initial states and clears transition highlights; omitted word reuses the current input.

methods.name: run(duration = 650): Promise<boolean>
methods.description: Processes remaining symbols with duration milliseconds per step, stopping at the end or rejection. Resolves to whether the complete word is accepted; does not reset the input first.

methods.name: setGraph(graph: TpGraphDocument): void
methods.description: Validates the specialized graph before replacing the editor graph; retains the base editor cloning and undo-history behavior. Invalid data throws without replacing the graph.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-graph-nfa>` element implements the <tp-icon name="graph-nfa" library="components" size="1.25em"></tp-icon> Nondeterministic finite automaton functionality: edits, generates, and simulates nondeterministic finite automata.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Using the component | The initial expression is `ab(a|b)*`. |
| Using the component | It recognizes words over `{a,b}` that start with `ab`. |
| Generate NFA | Change the expression and press **Generate NFA** to rebuild the graph. |
| Using the component | Automatic execution waits 650 ms between characters so that the active states remain visible. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Read next character | <kbd>Enter</kbd> a word, then use **Read next character** or **Run word**. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
